releases.title: Real social icons
fixed: The Discord, YouTube and TikTok buttons now show their real icons, so it's easy to see which is which

releases.title: Follow us
new: New FOLLOW FOR UPDATES buttons (Discord, YouTube, TikTok) above the game, in What's New, in the ? window and in About & FAQ. Our pages are coming soon!

releases.title: JOYJOY.GG in your browser tab
new: The browser tab now says JOYJOY.GG — Enjoy Good Games and has its own colourful JJ icon

releases.title: JOYJOY.GG when loading
new: The JOYJOY.GG logo now greets you while the game is loading
fixed: The logo above the game hides in full screen, also when you use the browser's own full screen (F11)

releases.title: New hero: Neon Oni Warlord
new: Meet NEON ONI WARLORD — a masked samurai warlord with glowing pink armour! Pick him in HEROES
He has 25 moves to show off, from a WARLORD COMBO to the penguin dance. Level him up to unlock them all

releases.title: Colourful motto
new: Our motto under the logo is now colourful: En in yellow, joy in pink and Good Games in the same colour as .GG

releases.title: JOYJOY.GG logo
new: The JOYJOY.GG logo and our motto "Enjoy Good Games" now sit above the game on computers

releases.title: Bigger top menu
fixed: The top menu now spreads across the whole bar with bigger text, also when the game is not in full screen

releases.title: 10 new moves for every hero
new: Every hero learned 10 new moves — over 20 moves each to collect
You start with 2 moves; every hero level unlocks one more

releases.title: More moves + match loading screen
new: Every hero level now unlocks 5 new moves — level 1 already has 5 moves to show off
A short loading screen with both heroes face to face shows before every match starts
fixed: Starting a match no longer jumps straight into the arena with a sudden screen flip

releases.title: Heroes face each other
fixed: Heroes now stand face to face with their opponent instead of looking away
Moves no longer spin or glitch at the start and end — every move plays smoothly from start to finish

releases.title: Your hero, your moves
fixed: In a match your hero now only moves when you tap a move — no more moves by himself when a round is won or lost or the match ends
The start of a match no longer looks glitchy (the lobby dance doesn't mix into the hero's stance any more)

releases.title: Smooth hero moves
fixed: Hero moves no longer glitch: when you tap a move, your hero now does the whole move smoothly from start to end
A move always finishes, even when the next round starts or the match ends

releases.title: New hero + many more moves
new: Meet STONE SENTINEL: a giant of mossy stone with glowing blue cracks. He does karate, a handstand, a flying kick — and even a penguin walk
Every hero now has 11 to 14 moves to unlock instead of 7 — dances, kicks, backflips and funny ones. Level up a hero to unlock the next move
The MOVES column shows how many moves you have unlocked and which one comes next

releases.title: Hero moves you choose
new: MOVES: during a match a column of move buttons sits on the left. Tap one and your hero does that move — a dance, a kick, a backflip. Online, your rival sees it too
Every hero starts with 2 moves and unlocks one more each time the hero levels up (log in to level up your heroes)
Above each hero you can now see the last card they played
fixed: Heroes no longer do moves on their own after every round — no more moves cut off halfway
A move always plays to the end before you can pick the next one

releases.title: Phone fixes
fixed: On phones the hero pictures in HEROES and HERO COLLECTION show the hero's face again instead of only the chest
On phones the screen between rounds no longer shows a big blurry picture at the bottom
On phones held sideways and in small windows, the top menu no longer hides under the round buttons
The loading bar keeps moving while the game loads

releases.title: New hero: Frostbound
new: Meet FROSTBOUND: a crystal ice warrior in blue and gold armour. He does hip-hop dances, sweeps his rival's legs when he wins a round and spin-jumps when he wins the match

releases.title: New hero: Frog Ronin
new: Meet FROG RONIN: a frog samurai with a straw hat and a red scarf. He dances, does big kicks when he wins a round, backflips when he wins the match — and sits down sulking when he loses
fixed: Heroes no longer jump to a different spot on the floor during some moves

releases.title: Loading screen + About & FAQ
new: A loading screen with the RPS RIVALS logo shows while the game gets ready, so you don't see the game flicker while it loads
If your internet is not working, the game now tells you and gives you a TRY AGAIN button
If your internet drops while you play, a message at the top tells you that the game is trying to reconnect
📖 ABOUT & FAQ in the ? window: who made the game, how crystals and hero levels work, how to play with friends, and more

releases.title: Heroes stand on the floor
fixed: In the lobby the heroes now stand on the floor instead of floating in the air
On phones the hero no longer hides behind the top bar on the OFFLINE page
Gearfox finishes his moves: calm waiting between rounds and his big victory dance only when he wins the match
Verdant Guardian falls down properly when he loses, instead of flying up into the sky first

releases.title: Two brand-new heroes
new: Meet GEARFOX: a clever fox mechanic with goggles, tools and a big fluffy tail. He spins, flexes and backflips when he wins
Meet VERDANT GUARDIAN: a forest warrior made of wood and leaves, with antlers on his head. He sweeps, throws seeds and dances
The old heroes have left the arena, so these two are the heroes for now. More new heroes are coming

releases.title: Arena prices on the cards
new: In the ARENAS panel every locked arena now shows its price (🔒 and how many crystals) right on the card, plus its name and rule, so you can see what it costs before you tap it

releases.title: Full PLAY button
fixed: The big PLAY button is a full rounded button again: its corners and glow are no longer cut off

releases.title: Top menu fits full screen
fixed: In full screen (and on big monitors) the top menu, the RPS RIVALS name and the round buttons now grow with the game instead of staying small and squeezed together

releases.title: Clearer rewards at the end of a match
fixed: At the end of a match the reward messages (💎 crystals, ⭐ hero XP, 🎁 presents) now show one under another, so you can read every one
The emote buttons (👋 😂 🔥 GG) in a room match no longer cover the sound and full-screen buttons, or your cards on a phone
The WHAT'S NEW and REPORT A BUG windows close by themselves when a match starts

releases.title: Report a bug
new: 🐞 REPORT A BUG: logged-in players can tell the game team about a bug, something that doesn't work, an idea, or a player who cheats. Find it in the ACCOUNT menu (☰ on phones) and in the ? window
See your own reports and when the game team has seen or fixed them — sometimes with a note from us

releases.title: Smaller PLAY button + fair rewards
fixed: The PLAY button in the lobby is smaller and never runs into the side boxes, in every theme
Online hero XP only counts when BOTH players are logged in and the match is confirmed by both — playing against a guest gives no XP, crystals or rank
After accepting a room invite, the PLAY ONLINE menu no longer stays open on top of the room

releases.title: Tutorial steps work again
fixed: After the tutorial (and after pressing PLAY) the steps at the top work again: choose ONLINE or OFFLINE, then your hero, then an arena (offline) or who to play with (online), and the game starts
The quick ONLINE / OFFLINE question for new players no longer shows steps that don't do anything

releases.title: Daily moved to your player card
new: DAILY is now the 📋 button on your player card, right under the 🔔 bell (for logged-in players). It shines and shows a red number when rewards are waiting
The top menu is shorter and tidier

releases.title: One GAME MODE button
new: ONLINE and OFFLINE are now one GAME MODE button in the top menu: pick friends, host, join, random player or VS COMPUTER in one place
The button shows the mode you are playing (for example VS COMPUTER or RANDOM PLAYER)
More room in the top menu, so nothing sits under the round buttons any more

releases.title: The big lobby update
new: UPDATES window: see what changed in every new version (this window!)
A banner tells you when a new update is ready while you play: just press RELOAD
Things you haven't finished yet (tutorial, daily missions, new updates) now shine in the lobby
Tutorial: a welcome card for new players and a guided tour of the lobby; the 🎓 button next to ? starts it any time
Private messages between friends and a 🔔 bell for friend requests and new messages
Themes: Moon Temple and Fire Forge are free; Magic Night, Sakura Dojo, Frost Kingdom and the legendary Golden Dragon in the theme shop
New top menu that works like browser tabs: heroes, arenas, rank, daily and theme open beside the game
Rank and weekly leaderboard always on the lobby
fixed: You stay logged in when you refresh the page
Pressing READY in a room now starts the match
Open rooms, guests and random-player search show up on phones too
All rooms are public unless you set a password
Arena row scrolls sideways on phones again
